title: Lipschitz continuity of Gaussian bivariate stability
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. On the square $[0,1]^2$, the function sending $(\alpha,\beta)$ to the Gaussian probability of the event that a standard Gaussian variable $Z$ satisfies $\Phi(Z)\le\alpha$ and $\Phi(\rho Z+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}W)\le\beta$, with $W$ an independent standard Gaussian variable, is Lipschitz with constant $2$ for the product metric.
